title: 웹 기반 토론 학습을 지원하는 전자 게시판의 설계 및 구현

abstracts.value:
본 연구의 목적은 웹 기반 토론 학습을 지원하는 게시판을 설계 및 구현하는 것이다. 기존의 웹 기반 토론 게시판에서 토론 학습의 저해요소를 찾았으며, 문헌 연구를 통하여 면대면 토론 및 웹 기반 토론의 촉진 요소들로부터 시사점을 찾았다. 여기에 웹 기반 학습 시스템을 설계하는데 필요한 인터페이스 요소들을 발췌하여 웹 기반 토론 학습 게시판 설계 및 구현에 적용하였다.
본 연구에서 설계 구현한 웹 기반 토론 학습 지원 전자 게시판은 토론방 별로 URL을 부여하여 학급단위 별로 관리되도록 하였고, 각 토론방 초기 화면을 변경할 수 있는 환경을 제공하여 개성있는 토론방을 쉽게 구축할 수 있도록 하였다. 또한 토론의 절차를 준비-전개-정리로 진행할 수 있도록 토론 설계하였다. 토론 활동의 촉진을 위하여 개인별, 소집단별 경쟁 체제를 도입하여 참여 의욕을 높이고, 토론 관리자에게는 토론 현황과 소집단별 토론 특성을 실시간으로 파악함으로써 적절한 피드백을 제공할 수 있도록 구현하였다.

This research is about the design and implementation of bulletin board system for web-based discussion. The research topics are as follows:
1. Reflection to the design and implementation of bulletin board system for web-based discussion, through identifying the factors for promotion and obstruction of discussion in the bulletin board for existing web-based discussion.
2. Design and implementation of bulletin board system for web-based discussion through identification of suggestions from the factors of face to face discussion and web-based discussion through literature research.
3. Application to the design and implementation of bulletin board system for web-based discussion through drawing the necessary interface factors in designing web-based learning system.
The characteristics of the bulletin board for web-based discussion designed and implemented in this research were as follows:
First, When discussion forums were open, URL was provided by each discussion forum, and authority to manage each discussion forum was granted to the person who opened each discussion forum. Therefore, bulletin board management for discussion was easily maintained by group (class). The management of the existing discussion bulletin board was focused on a bulletin board administrator, however, this discussion bulletin board could be operated by several administrators.
Second, There were many difficulties in conducting discussion by small groups, however, the discussion themes could be flexibly constituted by small groups in the bulletin board system and also theme setting by topics and small groups were possible designed and implemented in this research. The right to write and read in the bulletin board by small groups could be flexibly granted to the entire members or small groups, and a variety of discussion environment could be reflected.
Third, Individualized discussion forums by class or large group could be easily designed by diversely decorating each discussion topic screen and utilizing it via provision of environment, in which the initial screen of each discussion forum could be easily changed.
Fourth, the bulletin board suitable for discussion procedure was intended to design and implement. Preparation - Development - Conclusion procedure was also reflected to the bulletin board for discussion. The preparation stage for discussion purpose confirmation, discussion topic search, group formation and role adjustment and discussion was carried. In the development stage, the process of opinion presentation and opinion search can be experienced, so that actual discussion can be carried. The conclusion stage was designed and implemented in a way that conclusion, evaluation and task presentation could be conducted.
Fifth, a competition system by individuals and small groups was introduced in order to promote the discussion activities. With regard to discussion activity by individuals, the search of presentation king, king of diligence and king of recommendation, based on number of inquiries, number of opinions and number of recommendation, by ranking was possible. Regarding discussion activity by small groups, number of inquiries, number of opinions and number of recommendation could be used. Participation desire could be enhanced to people conducting a discussion, and adequate feedback could be provided to the discussion administrator by identifying discussion status and features of the discussion by small groups in real time.
Sixth, Discussion materials could be easily printed in line with the format. The bulletin board system was designed in a way that multi conversations could be optionally checked simultaneously to overcome an inefficiency that individual conversation should be checked to identify the flow of conversation.
